Helen Park  
Cambridge, MA | (617) 555-0198 | helen.park@email.com | linkedin.com/in/helenpark  
A seasoned embedded systems engineer with a track record of delivering scalable, reliable solutions for enterprise IoT applications. My work bridges hardware and software to create systems that operate with precision and efficiency. I thrive in environments where innovation meets practicality, and I’ve consistently demonstrated the ability to translate complex technical challenges into robust, production-ready outcomes.  

Senior Embedded Systems Engineer at NexGen Systems Inc. (2023–present)  
Led the integration of hardware and software for real-time monitoring systems used in industrial automation, reducing latency by 35% through optimized C/C++ code and RTOS scheduling. Designed firmware for edge devices that enabled seamless data aggregation from 50+ sensor nodes, improving system reliability by 22%. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deploy solutions across three major client sites, ensuring compliance with stringent safety and performance standards.  

Junior Embedded Engineer at IoTForge Labs (2021–2023)  
Developed firmware for edge devices using RTOS and MQTT protocols, enabling scalable IoT deployments for logistics tracking. Engineered low-power sensor nodes that extended battery life by 40% through dynamic power management techniques. Contributed to the architecture of a modular firmware framework, allowing rapid feature iteration and reducing development time by 25% for client projects.  

Embedded Systems Intern at TechNova Solutions (2020–2021)  
Supported the design of low-power sensor nodes for industrial IoT applications, focusing on optimizing energy efficiency in wireless communication modules. Wrote C/C++ code for microcontroller peripherals, achieving a 15% improvement in data transmission reliability. Conducted performance analysis of sensor networks, identifying bottlenecks and proposing architectural changes that enhanced system scalability.  

Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (2020)  
Focused on embedded systems and signal processing, with coursework in microcontroller design, real-time operating systems, and embedded firmware development. Graduated with honors, demonstrating a strong foundation in both theoretical and applied engineering principles.  

Projects / Side Projects  
- Real-Time Monitoring System: Developed a distributed monitoring platform for industrial machinery, integrating C/C++-based firmware with cloud analytics tools. The system reduced downtime by 28% for a pilot client.  
- Low-Power Sensor Network: Designed a mesh network of wireless sensors using MQTT for data aggregation, achieving 99.5% packet delivery reliability in field tests.  
- Smart Home Automation Device: Built a prototype for home energy management, leveraging RTOS for task prioritization and Python for API integration with third-party services.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
C/C++ (embedded systems, firmware development, real-time kernel optimization), RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr), IoT protocols (MQTT, CoAP), Python (scripting, API design), firmware development (bootloader creation, peripheral drivers), hardware-software integration (PCB design, signal integrity analysis), network automation (Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  

Certifications  
- Certified Embedded Systems Engineer (CES-E), IEEE (2022)  
- AWS Certified Developer – Associate (2021)  

Awards & Achievements  
- Top Performer, IoTForge Labs (2022)  
- Innovation Award, NexGen Systems Inc. (2023)  
- MIT Undergraduate Research Fellowship (2019)
